verdict.rationale: LangGraph's Agent Server publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Assistants, Threads, Runs, Crons, Store, A2A and MCP endpoints, and every server ships an interactive /docs reference. The CLI runs a local server that exposes all API endpoints, and the control-plane API documents path versioning. The probe's 404s on generic OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served at its own documented path. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy for the data-plane API, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: docs.langchain.com publishes the Agent Server (LangGraph Platform runtime) OpenAPI 3.1 document
The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc.
every deployed or locally run Agent Server ships a built-in interactive API docs endpoint
Each endpoint path is prefixed with a version (e.g. `v1`, `v2`)
